label: mid input positions (t=4-6) of sequences with d at position 1 or 2
explanation: Fires only in the original input phase at orig_idx 3-7 (peak 5); a few weak activations at <DEL>, and never in the copy phase. It is gated by early-sequence content: it is strongest when original token 1 and/or 2 is d (d d at positions 1-2 gives the top activations, about 85% precision), and an o one or two steps back adds to it. The predicate (t 4-6 with d at position 1 or 2) covers about 77% of activation mass but has only about 25% precision, because many such steps stay silent. Weak activations also show up without any d, so the feature looks like a fuzzy conjunction of position and early tokens (d, o, m, e) and not a clean token detector. It does not fire at t<3 or t>=8, or on any copy-phase output.
